Next compact calendar toolbar: arrows, 12–18 October 2026, America/New_York, Week(selected) / Agenda, small Filters control. State legend on same row: outlined diamond Proposed, outlined clock Queued locally, solid clock Provider confirmed. Small counts 3 proposed · 0 queued · 0 provider confirmed.
Below, LEFT UNPLACED TRAY about230px wide: heading Without a date. One honest entry Vrooli subreddit, reason Setup and moderation decision needed, action Open readiness. Below rule heading Needs preparation, entries LinkedIn draft · Review needed; Silent demo · Not recorded. Footer of tray Add intention +. No calendar days here.
The remaining 1300px is a LARGE SEVEN-COLUMN WEEK CALENDAR, equal columns Monday12 throughSunday18, horizontal bands Morning / Afternoon / Evening. Calendar is for publication intentions only, no human work sessions. Most space intentionally blank when no meaningful item. Three small highly legible outlined entries:
Thursday15 Afternoon: selected cobalt outline, LinkedIn, Evidence beside the decision, diamond Proposed.
Friday16 Morning: Personal X, One useful design change, diamond Proposed, Manual handoff.
Saturday17 Morning: YouTube, Three files, one view, diamond Proposed, Route unverified.
Use concise wraps and generous entry padding. Exact clock time is unspecified; no invented precise slots. A tiny pale banner under calendar says No confirmed releases in this illustrative week.
BOTTOM SELECTED-TARGET DRAWER across calendar area, about210px high with white surface and a thin cobalt top edge, clearly tied to selected Thursday cell. Heading LinkedIn · Proposed target. Horizontal editable fields Day: Thu 15 Oct, Window: Afternoon, Zone: America/New_York. Small lines Draft revision 1 · Needs wording review and Account eligibility: unverified. Blue button Save proposed target with adjacent text This does not schedule a release. Secondary Open draft →. Drawer close X at far right.
A separate slim bottom status strip full width: Human work: 180 min estimated · Provisional · Not reserved in Personal Planner, action Open Work →.
No decorative image. Only calendargeometry, tray, contextualdrawer, compact controls. Do not automatically fill blanks, show fake schedules, connect accounts or mix work minutes into publication cells. Dates and all states are illustrative. Header hierarchy no text above32px.
